title: Registration-History Credit: Community Rules & Site Care Billing Q&A
content:
Under Community Rules & Site Care, a registration-history credit is taken off a pet's registration-year fee by the registration-year fees already on the plan record's statement for any of the household's pets.

| Registration-year fees already on the statement | Credit |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | $10.00 |
| 3 or more but fewer than 6 | $5.00 |
| fewer than 3 | none |

The credit is taken off once every addition to the fee has been made, and the fee after the credit is never less than zero.

## Questions and answers

**Which fees are counted?** Every registration-year fee already on the plan record's statement, for any of the household's pets and any registration year.

**Where do the thresholds fall?** 2 fees earn no credit; 3 fees earn $5.00, as do 5; 6 fees earn $10.00.

**What if the credit is larger than the fee it is taken from?** The fee after the credit is never less than zero: a hypothetical $8.00 with a $10.00 credit comes to $0.00, not a negative amount.

**Hypothetical worked case.** A household's statement already carries four registration-year fees across two pets. The credit on the next fee is $5.00; after two more fees have been posted, the following fee earns $10.00.
